settings.cast.label: Roles and their holders
settings.cast.body: Who holds each role here, and why. A person and an agent hold a role alike: a step names its role, and its holder comes from this place, never step by step. High risk and your marks keep a role yours whatever is chosen here. Each choice is kept with the reason beside it. Only you set this: an agent’s press of it goes on your card in every mode.
settings.cast.why.label: Why (kept with each choice)
settings.cast.why.owner: The owner role is always yours.
settings.cast.why.marked: Your mark keeps production releases yours.
settings.cast.why.risk: High risk: no agent holds a role here.
settings.cast.why.default: Nobody else is chosen, so you hold it.
workflow.hold.label: Who holds this step
